messages.subject: For Jennifer Rumsey | Power systems, energy transition and government relations
messages.body:
Dear Cummins Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Jennifer Rumsey, Chair and Chief Executive Officer.

Cummins' power-systems and energy-transition agenda operates at the intersection of industrial transformation, public policy, sustainability and customer reliability. Those priorities align strongly with the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and energy-transition experience might support Cummins' priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Cummins.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
